stories.title: Around the World, Paris and 'giddiness': The dawn of the Ant-Melo era in Minnesota
stories.summary: The new LaMelo Ball-Anthony Edwards backcourt opens the season with a lot of flash and a renewed joy in Minnesota.

stories.title: Goodell: NFL welcomes investigation into Eagles QB Hurts' medical care
stories.summary: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said Wednesday that the league welcomes an investigation into the Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots.

stories.title: Ohtani won't require surgery; Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year'
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani will not require surgery to treat any ailment he dealt with this past season, Dodgers president of baseball operations Andrew Friedman said Wednesday. And: "I fully expect him to pitch next year," Friedman added.

stories.title: Hall of Fame hoops coach Huggins has progressive cognitive condition
stories.summary: Hall of Fame basketball coach Bob Huggins has a progressive cognitive condition that is affecting his memory and aspects of his daily life, his family said.

stories.title: Saleh defends ex-Titan Elliott, says gun incident was not 'criminal act'
stories.summary: Titans coach Robert Saleh defended Jordan Elliott's character and said that last week's gun-related incident was "a call for help more than a criminal act."
